name: assay
description: Measured priors for Nansen flow segments (a 12,781-call pre-registered study, scored, with its negative control) and the sampled state of labelled positioning on Hyperliquid perps — liquidation maps by holder, smart-money-versus-crowd crowding with funding, the smart-money tape — served to any agent over MCP. Every answer carries its sample, its age and its provenance; it refuses to hand out a signal it has not calibrated.
